items.title: Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland move to break up the UK
items.summary: Pop Base reported that the leaders of Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland would meet the next day to sign a deal designed to begin the break-up of the United Kingdom. The post got 188K likes, and "didn't expect to check twitter today and see that the uk is disbanding" got 86K.
items.author: @PopBase

post.name: Pop Base
post.text:
Leaders of Scotland, Wales & Northern Ireland will reportedly gather tomorrow to sign a deal that is designed to begin the break-up of the United Kingdom.

(telegraph.co.uk/politics/2026/…)
